    The Mocas are bold and infinitely creative beings who call the Mocaverse home. But years ago, an inexorable expansion of space caused the Mocas to separate.

    As they developed their technologies to advance the realms, the distance between them grew tenfold.

    However, the Mocas’ yearning for collaboration eventually produced an unstoppable force that draws and binds matter together.
    To share this Mocaverse ethos with others, the Mocas built a portal that serves as a conduit for other beings to travel into the Mocaverse. Their dream is to onboard the next billion beings via the portal conduit.
    They now know the realms will only truly flourish with united efforts to turn hopeful dreams into confident reality.
